config.quickstack.title: Quick Stack Configuration
config.quickstack.radius.tooltip: Radius in blocks to scan for nearby containers (1-16).
config.quickstack.min_slots.tooltip: Containers with fewer slots than this are ignored. Furnaces have 3, brewing stands have 5, dispensers have 9.
config.quickstack.button_offset_x.toolti: Horizontal pixel offset of the Quick Stack button from the inventory background's top-left corner.
config.quickstack.button_offset_y.toolti: Vertical pixel offset of the Quick Stack button from the inventory background's top-left corner.
